current.title: Farebi Pati
current.logline: Riya ki perfect shaadi ek jhooth ki buniyaad par khadi thi, jahan uska pati, Rohan, uske saare paison ka game khel raha tha. Ab jab sach saamne aaya hai, Riya uske dhoke ka badla aise legi ki Rohan zindagi bhar nahi bhoolega.
current.characters: Riya: CEO ki beti, naive aur trusting, baad mein bahadur aur badla lene wali. Rohan: Riya ka charming pati, asal mein penniless aur dhokebaaz schemer. Tina: Riya ki best friend, Rohan ki secret accomplice aur lover. Mr. Sharma: Riya ke father ka loyal ex-PA, jo Riya ki madad karta hai.
arc: Part 1: Riya aur Rohan ki shaadi ki pehli anniversary hai, sab kuch perfect lag raha hai. Audience ko pata chalta hai ki Rohan phone par kisi se paise aur Riya ki company ko hadapne ki baat kar raha hai. Riya ko Rohan ke drawer mein company se related ek ajeeb document milta hai, jise woh galti samajh kar chhod deti hai. Rohan insists karta hai ki woh Riya ki company ke ek bade project ko handle karega. Raat ko Riya ne Rohan ko ek unknown lawyer se 'property transfer' aur 'Riya ko pata nahi chalna chahiye' ke baare mein chup-chup kar baat karte suna. Uska dil baith gaya.

Part 2: Riya, Rohan se lawyer ke baare mein poochti hai. Rohan gusse mein bolta hai, 'Tum mujh par doubt kar rahi ho? Main toh bas tumhari help kar raha tha!' Woh Riya ko guilty feel karata hai. Riya apni best friend Tina se share karti hai, jo Rohan ka side leti hai, 'Rohan toh tumhe kitna pyaar karta hai.' Riya ko Rohan ke secretive phone calls aur messages par shak hota hai. Ek din kitchen mein coffee banate hue, Riya ne Rohan ko living room mein Tina se phone par kehte suna, 'Tina ko sab pata hai. Bas Riya ko nahi pata chalna chahiye ki uski company ab meri hone wali hai.' Coffee ka cup Riya ke haath se chhoot gaya.

Part 3: Sach sunkar Riya toot jaati hai — Rohan aur Tina, dono dhokebaaz hain. Lekin woh apni aankhon mein aansu chhipa kar Rohan se kehti hai, 'Sorry, Rohan, meri galti thi. Main tumpar bharosa karungi.' Rohan aur Tina, Riya ko company meetings mein beizzat karte hain, uski incompetence ka mazaak udaate hain. Rohan Riya ko kuch important looking papers par sign karne ko bolta hai. Riya secretly kuch documents ki copies banati hai aur apne father ke old PA, Mr. Sharma ko contact karti hai. Jaise hi Riya ne shares transfer karne wale document par sign kiya, uski nazron mein ek naya junoon dikha. 'Yeh sign toh main kar rahi hoon, Rohan... lekin iss deal ka asli hisaab abhi baaki hai.'

Part 4: Mr. Sharma, Riya ko Rohan ke saare fraud samjhate hain — kaise usne funds siphon kiye aur company ki ownership badli. Rohan aur Tina openly Riya ka mazaak udaate hain, use 'broken' aur 'bewakoof' samajhte hain. Riya ko Rohan ke laptop se ek important file nikalni thi, tabhi Rohan room mein aa jata hai, aur woh curtains ke peeche chhip jaati hai. Kuch der baad, Riya ek crucial file nikal kar office se bahar nikal rahi thi, tabhi saamne Tina aa gayi. Riya ne dekha Rohan Tina ko diamond necklace pehna raha hai, bilkul waisa jo Rohan ne Riya ko 'too expensive' kehkar mana kiya tha. Riya chupke se phone par record karti hai. Jaise hi woh stop button dabane wali thi, Rohan ne seedhe camera ki taraf dekha.

Part 5: Rohan ne camera ko notice nahi kiya, woh bas uske peeche dekh raha tha. Riya ki jaan mein jaan aayi. Mr. Sharma ki madad se, Riya ek fake 'Emergency Board Meeting' set karti hai, jahan Rohan company ka final takeover karne wala tha. Riya apni presentation prepare karti hai. Rohan overconfident hokar Tina se kehta hai, 'Kal subah 10 baje, Riya ki company meri hogi.' Agle din, Riya sharp dress mein board room mein enter karti hai, jahan Rohan aur Tina pehle hi board members ke saamne celebrate kar rahe the. Rohan Riya ko dekhkar smirks karta hai, 'Kya hua, wifey? Ready ho apni company ko bye-bye bolne ke liye?' Riya projector par apni USB lagati hai, aur ek video play hone lagta hai. Rohan ka smile gayab ho jata hai.

Part 6: Projector par Rohan aur Tina ki saari conversations, unke romantic moments, aur Rohan ka pura plan expose ho jata hai. Saare board members shocked reh jaate hain. Rohan panic mein chillata hai, 'Yeh sab jhooth hai! Riya, tum pagal ho gayi ho!' Woh video delete karne ki koshish karta hai, par Riya ne system lock kiya hua tha. Riya, Mr. Sharma ke saath, saare forged documents aur financial proof dikhati hai. Tina, khud ko bachane ke liye, Rohan par saara blame daal deti hai, 'Main toh bas majboor thi, sir!' Police board room mein enter karti hai. Rohan aur Tina ko arrest kiya jata hai, unke chehre par sharam aur shock saaf dikh raha tha. Riya lambi saans leti hai. Usne wahi pen uthaya jisse Rohan ne usse sign karvaye the. 'Ab, humein apni company ko wapas track par laana hai.' Uski aankhon mein ek winning smile thi. 'Let's begin.'
current.soFar: Riya ko apni shaadi aur pati Rohan ke dhoke ka sach pata chal gaya hai. Rohan aur Riya ki best friend Tina milkar Riya ki company ko hadapne ki saazish kar rahe the, aur Rohan ne Riya se shares transfer ke documents bhi sign karwa liye the. Lekin Riya ne badle ka plan bana liya hai aur apne papa ke purane PA, Mr. Sharma, ki madad se Rohan ke saare fraud ko expose karne ki taiyari kar rahi hai. Mr. Sharma ne Riya ko Rohan ke saare ghotalon ke baare mein bataya, jinmein funds siphon karna aur company ki ownership badalna shamil tha. Riya ne Rohan ke laptop se ek crucial file bhi nikaal li. Office se nikalte hue, Riya ne Rohan ko Tina ko wahi diamond necklace pehnate hue dekha jo Rohan ne Riya ko 'too expensive' bolkar mana kiya tha. Riya ne chupke se unke romantic moments aur Rohan ke dhoke ko phone par record kar liya.
current.cliffhanger: Riya ne saari baat record kar li. Ab woh record button off karne hi wali thi... tabhi Rohan ne apna sir uthaya... aur uski nazrein seedhe camera ki taraf gayi!
